# LinkedIn Job Change Tracker

> Schedule this on profile URLs you already have. A later run alerts you when the employer or the headline has changed.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.30 per 1,000.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-job-change-watch
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-job-change-watch`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You want a recurring alert, not a one-time export.

## Use something else when

You want one comparison against a company stored in your CRM. Use the Current Company Checker. The URL no longer opens. Use Fix Broken LinkedIn URLs first.

## Page

- Alert when a LinkedIn employer or headline changes: docs/linkedin-job-change-alerts.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
